scaffold._discoveryPainPoints:
1. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] NetSuite-Salesforce integration failure causing 9-month delay on 3-month project (intensity 9/10, stage: Order Processing) ← flagged as binding
2. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] 90+ Salesforce customizations making standard implementations complex and unstable (intensity 8/10, stage: Customer Engagement) ← flagged as binding
3. [ProcessHandoffFriction] Sales teams waste 3 days per week on admin and meetings instead of selling (intensity 8/10, stage: Activity Execution)
4. [DataSignalFriction] Lack of pre-visit customer intelligence requiring manual information gathering (intensity 7/10, stage: Pre-Visit Intelligence)
5. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] Staff forced to use multiple disparate systems due to integration failures (intensity 7/10, stage: Order Processing)
6. [IncentiveCapacityFriction] Distributors becoming order-takers instead of proactive sellers due to lack of tools (intensity 6/10, stage: Performance Enablement)
7. [GovernanceRiskFriction] Cannot enforce CRM usage KPIs due to system inadequacy causing staff disgruntlement (intensity 6/10, stage: Performance Tracking)
